findings.claim: Selftest mutates the real .claude/xunji_active_run pointer and its restoration is only crash-safe inside the try/finally; a crash before or during read/restore can leave the operator’s active-run pointer corrupted or pointing at a deleted temp directory.
findings.evidence: evidence/diff.txt:selftest block showing old_active read, _set_active_run, finally restore, evidence/test-log.txt
findings.recommended_action: Make the active-run pointer selftest hermetic by parameterizing or monkeypatching xunji_statusline.ACTIVE_RUN to a temporary path, and add cleanup of the temp directory. Optionally add a test for the _set_active_run failure/warning path.
findings.why: [panel:arkcli] [arkcli:kimi-k2.7-code] The Expected Invariant requires selftests to restore pre-existing active-run pointer. While the diff attempts restoration, the test reads and writes the actual global state file without isolation. A crash before the finally block executes can corrupt operator statusline state. This is a testing-hygiene blind spot not acknowledged in the report.

findings.claim: Selftest leaks temp directories — never cleans up `tmp/tmpXXXXXX/run/` after scaffold test
findings.evidence: `evidence/diff.txt:88-104` (selftest block lacks `shutil.rmtree` or equivalent cleanup of `active_rd.parent`)
findings.why: [panel:claude] Each selftest invocation leaves an orphaned scaffolded run under `repo/tmp/`; repeated runs accumulate garbage. The `finally` block only restores the active-run pointer, not the filesystem.

findings.claim: `import xunji_statusline` module-level side effects are unverified
findings.evidence: `evidence/diff.txt:54` adds `import xunji_statusline` at module top; no audit of `xunji_statusline.py` import-time behavior in evidence or review scope
findings.why: [panel:claude] If `xunji_statusline` has import-time side effects (file reads, connections, hooks), they would execute whenever `setup_run.py` is imported — not just when `_set_active_run()` runs. Likely innocuous but unverified.
